collection.title: ITS Season 18: Overheat — September hotfix mission curation

effect.text: ITS Season 18 does not permit ordinary Infinity Spec-Ops in official tournaments. The N5.3 Skill and Request SpecBall remain valid core rules outside that event restriction.
TEAM-OPS is a separate optional ITS Season 18 Extra. It does not permit Infinity Spec-Ops, and Request Tacball does not replace the core Request SpecBall procedure.

ITS Season 18 offers Reinforcements as an optional Extra, not as a rule for all N5 games. Its availability here does not independently certify unchanged N4-origin Reinforcements procedures as newly published N5 mechanics.

records.name: Crossing Lines
records.summary: Control two Dead Zones and activate Antennas in a split-deployment mission; HVTs and the Classified Deck are excluded.

condition.text: At the end of the game, Dominate both Dead Zones.

rules.name: Deployment and Exclusion Zones
paragraphs: Each side has a rear Deployment Zone and a second Deployment Zone in the opposing half of the table inside the central strip. Up to 75 Army Points of Troops can deploy in that central strip.
The two Dead Zones lie between the Deployment Zones, and are Exclusion Zones: Airborne Deployment and Superior Deployment cannot be used to deploy inside them.
No Trooper may deploy in Silhouette contact with an Antenna. Superior Deployment Skills are prohibited in this scenario except Impersonation.

rules.name: Dominate a Zone of Operations
paragraphs: A player Dominates a Zone of Operations if they have more Victory Points of eligible Troopers inside than their opponent.
Count Models, Trooper Markers, Proxies and Peripheral Troops in non-Null States. Equipment Tokens and fake Holoechoes do not count; more than half of a Trooper's base must lie within the Zone.
Troopers with [[skill:shasvastii]] count in Unconscious or other non-Null States; eligible [[equipment:baggage]] Troopers contribute an additional 20 Victory Points.

rules.name: Activate Antenna
paragraphs: Two 40 mm Transmission Antennas are placed on the central line at the positions shown in the map.
Only Specialist Troops in Silhouette contact with an Antenna may use the Activate Antenna Short Skill: a successful Normal WIP Roll activates it for that player; failed attempts may be retried.
An Antenna can be activated by the opponent, replacing the previous player's ownership Token.

rules.name: Specialist Troops
paragraphs: Only Hackers, Doctors, Engineers, Forward Observers, Paramedics, Troopers with Chain of Command, and Specialist Operatives qualify as Specialist Troops for this mission.
Hackers, Doctors and Engineers cannot use Repeaters or Peripheral (Servant) Models for Specialist tasks.

rules.name: HVT and Classified Deck not used
paragraphs: Neither player deploys an HVT or uses the Classified Deck. The HVT and Secure HVT rules do not apply.

condition.text: If a player begins their Active Turn in a Retreat! situation, the mission ends at the end of that Player Turn.

records.name: Double Bind
records.summary: Choose distinct Encryption, Sabotage or Secure Vector Main Objectives at the Deployment decision, plus secondary and Classified scoring.

objectives.name: Encryption: at least one Activated Antenna

condition.text: Encryption Main Objective only: have at least one Activated Antenna at the end of each Game Round.

objectives.name: Encryption: two or more Activated Antennas

condition.text: Encryption Main Objective only: have at least two Activated Antennas at the end of each Game Round, awarding one additional point.

objectives.name: Secure Vector: Dominate a Zone of Influence

condition.text: Secure Vector Main Objective only: Dominate at least one Zone of Influence at the end of each Game Round.

objectives.name: Secure Vector: Dominate two or more Zones

condition.text: Secure Vector Main Objective only: Dominate at least two Zones of Influence at the end of each Game Round, awarding one additional point.
Complete the one Classified Objective assigned to this player.

rules.name: Choose one Main Objective set per player
paragraphs: The player who chose Deployment must choose Encryption, Sabotage, or Secure Vector at that same moment. Their opponent then chooses one of the two remaining sets.
Each player scores only the Main Objectives in their own selected set. Secondary and Classified Objectives are additional; the three Main Objective sets are not cumulative.

rules.name: Exclusion Zone
paragraphs: The central Exclusion Zone extends [[distance:4:inch]] to either side of the table's central line. Airborne Deployment and Superior Deployment cannot be used to deploy in this area.

rules.name: Antennas and Automated Defense System
paragraphs: Three 40 mm Antennas are on the central line. Each has ARM 5, BTS 5, STR 3, Silhouette 3, Fixed CC Roll 8 and GizmoKit (PH=9). The Antennas can be targeted as Objectives only by Troopers whose player selected Sabotage.
Every CC Attack against an Antenna triggers its Fixed CC Roll 8 in a Face to Face Roll; no positive MODs may apply to the attacker's CC Attribute.
A successful defensive roll inflicts one Stun Ammunition hit with PS 5 against BTS. Immunity (Enhanced) and Immunity (BTS) do not prevent this hit.

rules.name: Destroy Antennas
paragraphs: Only CC Attacks with Anti-materiel Weapons or placed D-Charges can damage an Antenna as an Objective.

An Antenna is destroyed and removed when Wounds equal or exceed STR 3. Only one Antenna can be destroyed per Player Turn; once one is destroyed, damage to any other Antenna during that turn does not apply.
A Destroyed Activated Antenna still counts as Activated. Antennas may be targets of [[skill:engineer]] or GizmoKit.

rules.name: Activate Antenna
paragraphs: Specialist Troops in Silhouette contact with an Antenna can activate it with a Normal WIP Roll. Success sets that player's ownership; the opponent can activate it later to replace ownership.
A Hacker fully inside the Zone of Influence of a destroyed Antenna can activate the destroyed Antenna with a Normal WIP-3 Roll.

rules.name: Zones of Influence
paragraphs: Each Antenna is the center of a Circular Template defining its Zone of Influence, also a Zone of Operations.
A player Dominates a Zone of Operations if they have more Victory Points of eligible Troopers inside than their opponent.
Count Models, Trooper Markers, Proxies and Peripheral Troops in non-Null States. Equipment Tokens and fake Holoechoes do not count; more than half of a Trooper's base must lie within the Zone.
Troopers with [[skill:shasvastii]] count in Unconscious or other non-Null States; eligible [[equipment:baggage]] Troopers contribute an additional 20 Victory Points.

rules.name: Specialist Troops
paragraphs: Only Hackers, Doctors, Engineers, Forward Observers, Paramedics, Troopers with Chain of Command, and Specialist Operatives qualify as Specialist Troops for this mission.
Hackers, Doctors and Engineers cannot use Repeaters or Peripheral (Servant) Models for Specialist tasks.

rules.name: Killing
paragraphs: A Trooper counts as Killed if it enters Dead State, is in a Null State at game end, or was not deployed on the table as a Model or Marker when the game ends.

condition.text: If a player begins their Active Turn in a Retreat! situation, the mission ends at the end of that Player Turn.

records.name: The Dig
records.summary: Analyze and neutralize Hyperthermal Tech Tokens, control Console ownership and complete Classified Objectives from opposing corner Deployment Zones.

condition.text: For each Hyperthermal Tech previously Analyzed by the player and Neutralized by their Trooper (maximum three Techs).

objectives.name: Neutralize at least one each round

condition.text: Have Neutralized at least one Hyperthermal Tech in each of the three Game Rounds.
Have more Consoles marked with the player's own Player Token than the opponent has marked.
Complete each of the player's two Classified Objectives (one Objective Point each).

rules.name: Deployment and Consoles
paragraphs: Players deploy in opposite corner quarter-circle Deployment Zones with radii shown in the map. Three Consoles of 40 mm diameter lie on the table diagonal at the published map positions.
Troopers cannot deploy in Silhouette contact with a Console or Hyperthermal Tech.

rules.name: Place six Hyperthermal Tech Tokens
paragraphs: Before Deployment, each player places three Hyperthermal Techs; the player who kept Deployment places their three first.

At 150 Army Points each 25 mm Tech Token must be completely outside [[distance:4:inch]] of either Deployment Zone and of every other Tech Token. At 200–400 points the minimum distance is [[distance:8:inch]].
Tech Tokens must be in accessible positions and cannot be on top of or inside scenery. These player-placed Tokens have no fixed coordinates in the map.

rules.name: Analyze Hyperthermal Tech (Short Skill)
paragraphs: Only a Specialist Troop in Silhouette contact with a Console lacking their own Player Token may Analyze Hyperthermal Tech.
Make a Normal WIP Roll; success marks that Console with the active player's Token and removes any opponent Token on it. Failed attempts can be retried with additional Short Skills.

If that player has Analyzed or Neutralized fewer than three Tech Tokens, the opponent chooses one not yet Analyzed Tech Token; mark it with the active player's Token. The same player cannot Analyze again through a Console already carrying their own Token.

rules.name: Neutralize Hyperthermal Tech (Short Skill)
paragraphs: Any Trooper in Silhouette contact with an Analyzed Hyperthermal Tech carrying their own Player Token may Neutralize it without a Roll; remove that Tech Token from the table.

rules.name: Specialist Troops
paragraphs: Only Hackers, Doctors, Engineers, Forward Observers, Paramedics, Troopers with Chain of Command, and Specialist Operatives qualify as Specialist Troops for this mission.
Hackers, Doctors and Engineers cannot use Repeaters or Peripheral (Servant) Models for Specialist tasks.

rules.name: Operational Learning
paragraphs: When the same Specialist Troop fails a WIP Roll for a Scenario-labelled Skill, a consecutive attempt on the same target receives +3 WIP on the second Order and +3 WIP and +1 Success Die from the third Order onward.

The sequence resets on success, a different Skill or target, an interruption, or an Order spent on another Trooper. These MODs can stack with other applicable Scenario Skill MODs; one sequence per Trooper and Skill at a time.

condition.text: If a player begins their Active Turn in a Retreat! situation, the mission ends at the end of that Player Turn.

records.name: Annihilation
records.summary: Season 18 Direct Action mission, suitable for Reinforcements: score by enemy Army Points killed, surviving Victory Points and the enemy Lieutenant eliminated. Retreat! does not apply.

rules.name: Killing
paragraphs: An enemy Trooper counts as Killed after entering [[state:dead]] or if it is in a Null [[trait:state|State]] at the end of the game.
A Trooper not deployed on the table as a Model or Marker by the end of the game also counts as Killed by the adversary.

rules.name: No Quarter
paragraphs: The Retreat! rules do not apply in this scenario.

rules.name: HVT and Classified Deck not used
paragraphs: Players do not deploy an HVT Model or use the Classified Deck. The Secure HVT rule does not apply.

sourceIssues.description: Both September hotfix PDFs print 176–274 for the 3-point band and more than 275 for the 4-point band, leaving exactly 275 points without a printed award. Preserve the source gap pending official clarification; do not infer a corrected boundary.

Both September hotfix PDFs print 176–274 for the 3-point band and more than 275 for the 4-point band, leaving exactly 275 points without a printed award. Preserve the source gap pending official clarification; do not infer a corrected boundary.

English 2026.09.11 p. 126 awards 4 Objective Points for more than 300 surviving Victory Points. Spanish p. 132 prints more than 30; preserve the English source value and record the bilingual discrepancy rather than interpreting the Spanish overlap as a second scoring rule.

records.name: Battleground
records.summary: Season 18 Direct Action mission: dominate three Zones of Operations at the end of the game. No Classified Objectives or HVT are used.

rules.name: Sectors (ZO)
paragraphs: Three Sectors are identified only when the game has finished, not before. Each is a Zone of Operations spanning the table width. The central Sector straddles the table centre; the other two are on opposite sides.

In 150-point games, each Sector is [[distance:4:inch]] deep, with the outer Sectors positioned [[distance:2:inch]] from the central line. In 200-400-point games, each Sector is [[distance:8:inch]] deep, with the outer Sectors positioned [[distance:4:inch]] from the central line.
The displayed map locates the end-of-game scoring areas for reference; it does not instruct players to mark the areas before the game ends.

rules.name: Dominate a Zone of Operations
paragraphs: A player Dominates a Sector when they have more Victory Points of eligible Troopers inside it than their opponent. Models, Trooper Markers, Proxies and [[skill:peripheral|Peripheral]] Troops count; Troopers in a Null [[trait:state|State]], equipment Tokens and fake Holoechoes do not.
More than half of a Trooper's base must lie inside the Sector for it to count toward Dominating that Zone of Operations.

rules.name: Embryo eligibility
paragraphs: Troopers possessing [[skill:shasvastii|Shasvastii]] count toward Domination while in [[state:unconscious|Unconscious]] or any non-Null [[trait:state|State]].

rules.name: Bonus for equipped Troopers
paragraphs: [[equipment:baggage|Baggage]] grants an additional 20 Victory Points toward Dominating the Sector when its Trooper is inside that Sector and is in a non-Null [[trait:state|State]].

rules.name: Killing
paragraphs: Troopers count as Killed if they enter [[state:dead|Dead State]], are in a Null [[trait:state|State]] when the game ends, or were not deployed on the table as a Model or Marker by the end of the game.

rules.name: HVT and Classified Deck not used
paragraphs: Players do not deploy an HVT Model or use the Classified Deck. The Secure HVT rule does not apply.

records.name: Cutthroat
records.summary: ITS Season 18 Direct Action mission suitable for Reinforcements. Lieutenants remain public and can be reassigned without Loss of Lieutenant; score by enemy Army Points killed, Lieutenant kills and Lieutenant-led eliminations.

objectives.name: Kill the same number of enemy Lieutenants

condition.text: Kill the same number of enemy [[skill:lieutenant|Lieutenants]] as the opponent, provided this player killed at least one enemy Lieutenant.
Kill more enemy Troopers with any of your [[skill:lieutenant|Lieutenants]] than the adversary does with theirs.

rules.name: Reinforced Tactical Link
paragraphs: The [[rule:loss-of-lieutenant|Loss of Lieutenant]] rule does not apply in this mission.
The identity of every Lieutenant is Open Information, including which Marker represents them while Camouflaged, Decoyed or using Holoprojector.
A Lieutenant must be placed on the game table as a Model or Marker at the beginning of Game Round 1. Hidden Deployment is not permitted for the Lieutenant.

During the Tactical Phase of their Active Turn, a player without an eligible Lieutenant because the current Lieutenant is undeployed, Isolated or in a Null State must name a replacement without spending an Order. The new Lieutenant's identity is also Open Information, and the replacement must be on the game table as a Model or Marker.

rules.name: Killing
paragraphs: An enemy Trooper is considered Killed when it enters Dead State or is in a Null State at the end of the game.
A Trooper not deployed on the game table as a Model or Marker by the end of the game counts as Killed by the adversary.
A Trooper counts as a Killed Lieutenant if they held the Lieutenant role at any time during the game and enter Dead State or are in a Null State at the end of the game.

rules.name: No Quarter
paragraphs: The Retreat! rules do not apply in this mission.

rules.name: HVT and Classified Deck not used
paragraphs: Players do not deploy an HVT Model or use the Classified Deck. The Secure HVT rule does not apply.

sourceIssues.description: English 2026.09.11 p. 133 explicitly counts a Trooper who was a Lieutenant at any time during the game as a Killed Lieutenant when it enters Dead State or ends in a Null State. Spanish p. 138 does not include that explicit sentence; retain the English wording and record the omission rather than assuming the two publications are identical.

Both English p. 133 and Spanish p. 138 include a Killing paragraph about Key Ops credit. Cutthroat provides no Key Ops selection or designation procedure. Do not infer a Key Ops role or scoring bonus for this mission without an applicable official source.

records.name: Superiority
records.summary: ITS Season 18 Direct Action mission. Dominate more of the four central Quadrants at each Game Round's end and Hack four Consoles; specialists benefit from Operational Learning. HVT and Classified Deck are excluded.

objectives.name: Dominate more Quadrants each Game Round

rules.name: Quadrants (ZO)
paragraphs: At the end of each Game Round, and not before, divide the central part of the table into four Quadrants as shown on the map. Each Quadrant is a Zone of Operations (ZO).

A ZO is Dominated by the player with more Victory Points in it. Count Troopers represented by Models or Markers, including Proxies and Peripherals; exclude Troopers in a Null State and Tokens representing weapons, equipment or false Holoechoes.
A Trooper is inside a ZO only when more than half its base is inside that area.

rules.name: Shasvastii
paragraphs: For purposes of Dominating a ZO, the English edition states that Troopers with [[skill:shasvastii|Shasvastii]] count while Unconscious or in any non-Null State. The Spanish edition instead names Normal and Shasvastii-Embryo States. The source difference is noted below.

rules.name: Baggage
paragraphs: A Trooper with [[equipment:baggage|Baggage]] inside a ZO adds 20 Victory Points toward Dominating that ZO while it is not in a Null State.

rules.name: Consoles
paragraphs: Four Consoles occupy the center of the four Quadrants. Each is a Console A Token or scenery piece 40 mm in diameter.

rules.name: Hack Consoles
paragraphs: Hack Consoles is an Attack, Scenario Short Skill. A Specialist Troop in Silhouette contact with a Console may make a Normal WIP Roll to Hack it; failed attempts may be repeated by spending another Short Skill.

The opposing player may Hack a previously Hacked Console. Both players then count the Console as Hacked for their end-of-game Objective Points; use different Player Tokens to track each player's success.

rules.name: Specialist Troops
paragraphs: Only Hackers, Doctors, Engineers, Forward Observers, Paramedics and Troopers with [[skill:chain-of-command|Chain of Command]] or [[skill:specialist-operative|Specialist Operative]] count as Specialist Troops for this mission.
Hackers, Doctors and Engineers cannot use Repeaters or Peripheral (Servant) Models for tasks reserved to Specialist Troops.

rules.name: Operational Learning
paragraphs: When a Specialist Troop fails a WIP Roll for a Scenario-labelled Skill, its next consecutive Order with the same Skill and target gains +3 to the WIP Roll. The third and subsequent consecutive Orders gain +3 and +1SD; these MODs stack with other applicable Scenario Skill MODs.
This sequence resets after success, using a different Skill or target, or spending an Order on another Trooper. Only one sequence per Trooper and per Scenario-labelled Skill may apply at once.

rules.name: HVT and Classified Deck not used
paragraphs: Players do not deploy an HVT Model, Secure HVT does not apply, and the Classified Deck is not used in this mission.

condition.text: If a player begins their Active Turn in a Retreat! situation, the mission ends at the end of that Player Turn.

sourceIssues.description: English 2026.09.11 p. 136 says Shasvastii Troopers within a ZO count in Unconscious State or any non-Null State. Spanish p. 141 instead names Normal and Shasvastii-Embryo States, omitting the explicit Unconscious condition. Preserve the two source descriptions and seek clarification before claiming equivalence.
